workload.acceptance_path: Go YjsService.Submit -> private HTTP runtime -> PostgreSQL CommitYjs
workload.notes: Client generation and initialization excluded. Sorted acceptance latency; runtime/commit phase diagnostics are chronological. Native processes share the host; latency is not a capacity/SLO claim. Logical historical state bytes count references; they do not describe physical disk usage.

INSERT INTO canvas.collab_version(id,document_id,epoch,revision,document_json,actor_id,reason,writer_term,commit_seq,state,graph_hash)
SELECT  $1 ,document_id,epoch, $2 , $3 ::jsonb, $4 , $5 ,writer_term,commit_seq,state,graph_hash FROM canvas.collab_document WHERE document_id= $6  AND epoch= $7  AND content_revision= $8 
ON CONFLICT(document_id,revision) DO NOTHING
UPDATE canvas.collab_document SET commit_seq= $1 ,content_revision= $2 ,state= $3 ,graph_hash= $4 ,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE document_id= $5
